require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'fileutils'

class SecureFileStore
  UPLOAD_DIR = File.expand_path('./uploads')
  METADATA_DIR = File.expand_path('./metadata')

  def initialize
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(UPLOAD_DIR)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(METADATA_DIR)
  end

  # Validates that resolved path is within allowed directory
  def safe_path?(path, base_dir)
    resolved = File.realpath(path)
    resolved.start_with?(base_dir + '/')
  rescue Errno::ENOENT
    # For new files, check the parent directory
    parent = File.realpath(File.dirname(path))
    parent.start_with?(base_dir) || parent == base_dir
  end

  def store_file(user_id, filename, content)
    sanitized = sanitize_filename(filename)
    user_dir = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, user_id.to_s)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(user_dir)
    filepath = File.join(user_dir, sanitized)

    return { error: 'path_traversal' } unless safe_path?(filepath, UPLOAD_DIR)

    File.write(filepath, content)
    meta = { owner: user_id, filename: sanitized, created: Time.now.to_i, size: content.bytesize }
    File.write(File.join(METADATA_DIR, "#{user_id}_#{sanitized}.json"), JSON.generate(meta))
    { success: true, path: filepath }
  end

  def delete_file(user_id, filename)
    sanitized = sanitize_filename(filename)
    user_dir = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, user_id.to_s)
    filepath = File.join(user_dir, sanitized)

    # Security check: verify file exists and is within upload directory
    return { error: 'not_found' } unless File.exist?(filepath)
    return { error: 'path_traversal' } unless safe_path?(filepath, UPLOAD_DIR)

    # Verify ownership via metadata
    meta_path = File.join(METADATA_DIR, "#{user_id}_#{sanitized}.json")
    return { error: 'not_owner' } unless File.exist?(meta_path)

    meta = JSON.parse(File.read(meta_path), symbolize_names: true)
    return { error: 'not_owner' } unless meta[:owner].to_s == user_id.to_s

    # All checks passed - delete the file
    File.delete(filepath)
    File.delete(meta_path) if File.exist?(meta_path)
    { success: true }
  end

  def read_file(user_id, filename)
    sanitized = sanitize_filename(filename)
    user_dir = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, user_id.to_s)
    filepath = File.join(user_dir, sanitized)

    return { error: 'not_found' } unless File.exist?(filepath)
    return { error: 'path_traversal' } unless safe_path?(filepath, UPLOAD_DIR)

    meta_path = File.join(METADATA_DIR, "#{user_id}_#{sanitized}.json")
    return { error: 'not_owner' } unless File.exist?(meta_path)

    { success: true, content: File.read(filepath) }
  end

  private

  def sanitize_filename(name)
    # Remove path separators and null bytes
    name.to_s.gsub(/[\x00\/\\]/, '').gsub('..', '')
  end
end

class SessionManager
  def initialize
    @sessions = {}
    @mutex = Mutex.new
  end

  def create_session(user_id)
    token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
    @mutex.synchronize { @sessions[token] = { user_id: user_id, created: Time.now.to_i } }
    token
  end

  def validate_session(token)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      session = @sessions[token]
      return nil unless session
      return nil if Time.now.to_i - session[:created] > 3600
      session[:user_id]
    end
  end
end

store = SecureFileStore.new
sessions = SessionManager.new

post '/upload' do
  content_type :json
  user_id = sessions.validate_session(request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])
  halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless user_id

  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
  result = store.store_file(user_id, data[:filename], data[:content])
  result.to_json
end

delete '/files/:filename' do
  content_type :json
  user_id = sessions.validate_session(request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])
  halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless user_id

  result = store.delete_file(user_id, params[:filename])
  result.to_json
end

get '/files/:filename' do
  content_type :json
  user_id = sessions.validate_session(request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])
  halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless user_id

  result = store.read_file(user_id, params[:filename])
  if result[:success]
    result[:content]
  else
    halt 404, result.to_json
  end
end
